encoder_method_note:
The message is encoded in the heights of the skyline buildings: each building's height is 10 times the alphabetical position of a letter (a=10, b=20, … z=260), so for example 190 = s, 10 = a, 200 = t, 210 = u, 180 = r, 140 = n spells "saturn". Buildings are read left to right, with each word held in its own `<g>` group and the word breaks marked by the small trees placed in the gaps between groups. The window pattern, moon, stars, and antenna are purely decorative and carry no information.
